title: Drop Me a Vine
description: A small mod that makes all vines drop when broken.
body:
Need more vines in your Minecraft game? Just drop me a line!

Drop Me a Vine is a small Minecraft mod that makes the following changes:

*   Vines now drop when broken with a Silk Touch enchanted tool.
*   Vines now drop when broken with any vanilla axe.
*   When you break a vine block that has other vines hanging beneath it, all the vines hanging beneath will also drop vine items.

That's all! I hope you enjoy this little mod if you want it to be easier to gather vines.

The first two bullet items are achieved by a Forge global loot modifier. You can make a data pack to adjust this. For example, you could remove the part that lets axes obtain vine drops. You could also add more axes or other tools to the forge:tools/axe tag.
